profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Platform & Architecture Expert
profile.summary:
I’m a Principal Software Engineer and technical leader with 18+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling complex enterprise systems. My career has progressed from Senior Engineer to Principal, leading teams, modernizing legacy platforms, and shaping architecture for mission-critical applications.

I specialize in full-stack development, platform architecture, and system integrations, with hands-on experience in Angular, Node.js/TypeScript, microservices, Docker, and Java-based enterprise systems. I’ve led major platform migrations, redesigned user experiences, and implemented scalable, maintainable solutions for both internal and client-facing applications.

As a team lead and manager, I coach and mentor engineers, ensure high-quality delivery, and foster alignment across teams, including remote and offshore collaborators. I also regularly collaborate with DevOps and architecture teams to troubleshoot production issues, guide deployments, and make long-term technical decisions.

I thrive at the intersection of technical excellence and team leadership, ensuring that engineering teams can deliver innovative solutions while maintaining system stability, scalability, and maintainability.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
After another round of restructuring, my role shifted toward deep technical work. I remained the team lead for the Benefit Enrollment and Onboarding applications, but with a stronger focus on architecture, design, and hands-on development.

I’m the subject matter expert for the platform and its integrations with other internal products. Most of my time goes into shaping new features, modernizing older parts of the stack, and working closely with the architecture group to define patterns and drive long-term technical decisions.

I also handle a large portion of the production troubleshooting. I work directly with the DevOps team on deployments, incident investigation, and system-level issues. When needed, I step in to diagnose problems outside of my immediate applications to keep the platform stable.

On the team side, I continue to coach engineers, keep the group aligned, and ensure we deliver work that follows the standards and direction set at the architectural level.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
I continued overseeing the Benefit Enrollment and Onboarding teams and added another engineering group under my management (with its own team lead). The role expanded my planning, coaching, and technical oversight responsibilities across more engineers and a larger product footprint.

We also integrated offshore resources and fully transitioned into remote work, which forced us to refine communication and processes to keep everyone aligned.

A major initiative during this period was the complete UX redesign of the Benefit Enrollment and Onboarding applications. I coordinated the engineering work with design, product, and other teams to modernize the experience without disrupting ongoing roadmap goals.

positions.title: Manager, Software Development
positions.description:
I continued leading the Benefit Enrollment team and, after a company restructure, took ownership of the Onboarding application as well. Both products shared the same legacy stack, so part of the work was stabilizing the platform while moving it forward.

We migrated from AngularJS and Play to a more modern approach:

* Front end moved to Angular
* Backend split into Node.js + TypeScript microservices
* Services were containerized with Docker

As a manager, I stayed involved in technical decisions but also took on people-related responsibilities—hiring, annual reviews, PTO approvals, workload planning, and keeping the team on track through significant architectural changes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I was part of the Benefit Enrollment team, where we built a new application from the ground up. Most of my work focused on the front-end and service layer, using AngularJS, JavaScript, Scala, and the Play framework. I also handled several reporting and data tasks in Unidata, which gave me a solid view of how the product behaved end-to-end.

I spent a good amount of that time making architectural calls, cleaning up technical debt, and pushing the team toward more consistent patterns. By the end of this period, I stepped into the Engineering Team Lead role. That shift pulled me deeper into technical decision-making and the day-to-day health of the team—removing blockers, making sure people had what they needed, and keeping the group aligned and motivated.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · TypeScript · GitHub · Node.js · Docker Products · Software Design

positions.title: Master Software Engineer
positions.description:
Recognized as an expert within the organization. Anticipates internal and external business  challenges and recommends improvements in processes, products and services. Solve complex problems with wide impact in the organization. Contributes the development of the functional strategy. Works without supervision, act with total autonomy in a complex environment.

Manage Java projects related with the electoral systems, specifically the server side. This includes the design and implementation of new requirements, as well as the maintenance and improvement of existing functionality. Responsible for overseeing the development and product team, distribution of the requirements, and monitor the performance of each team member. Ensure that the team applies the different development methodologies, such as agile methodologies. Coordinate the tests to check the status of individual applications as well as identify future improvements. Also assure that everything meets the client requeriments.

Some of the technologies used in such solutions are: Java 7, Jboss 7.1.1, J2EE, GWT, Servlet, JSP, Java Transaction API, JDBC, Web Services, Restful Services, XML, JSON , EML, HTML, JavaScript, AngularJS, Swing.

positions.title: Software Lead
positions.description:
Manage Java projects related with the electoral systems, specifically the server side. This includes the design and implementation of new requirements, as well as the maintenance and improvement of existing functionality. Responsible for overseeing the development team, distribution of the requirements, and monitor the performance of each team member. Ensure that the team applies the different development methodologies, such as agile methodologies. 

Also, interact with the quality team to check the status of individual applications as well as identify future improvements. 

Some of the technologies used in such solutions are: Java 1.6, Jboss 5.1, J2EE, GWT, Servlet, JSP, Java Transaction API, JDBC, Web Services, XML, EML, HTML, JavaScript, Swing, RMI.

Among the technologies used in such solutions are: Java 1.5, Jboss 4.2.3, J2EE, JDBC, GWT, Servlet, JSP, Java Transaction API, Web Services, XML, EML, HTML, JavaScript, Swing.

positions.title: Senior Consulting
positions.description: Responsible for coding and debugging programs,  analyzing requeriments and providing technical support and solutions for clients. Also the analysis, design, development and implementation of the new enterprise applications. The principal technology used was Java and J2EE

positions.description: Smart Card study, development, homologation and certification. Feasibility study and development of new products and services related to SIM Cards. Also work in the development of tools that allowed the certification of Simcards for distribution.

projects.title: Philippines Elections 2010
projects.description:
Integration and appropriateness of the electoral platform with the requirements of the Philippine electoral commission. Support of the auditing process that was carried out by an American company in Denver, Colorado. Configuration and monitoring the election of the different platforms during the event. On-site support for any eventuality.

Principal technologies used:  Java 1.6, Jboss 5.1, J2EE, GWT, Servlet, JSP, Java Transaction API, JDBC, Web Services, XML, EML, HTML, JavaScript, Swing, RMI.

projects.title: Bidding process Philippines 2009
projects.description:
Ensure that the electoral platform meets all the requirements stated in the RFP to win the tender for the Philippine national elections 2010. For this process we needed to interact with a Canadian partner who provided the voting machines, so we had to design and implement a new scheme for reception and processing of results. 

Principal technologies used: Java 1.6, Jboss 5.1, J2EE, GWT, Servlet, JSP, Java Transaction API, JDBC, Web Services, XML, EML, HTML, JavaScript, Swing, RMI.
